suggestions.title: "Pl/ork" is spelled out 790 lines after you coin it

edits.before: Reparenting means consciously evolving and molding a better Inner Adult inside you, comprising a loving Nurturer, a safe Adult Protector (hereafter just the Protector) and a wise Guide. All that sounds like my Nurturer, Protector and Guide by other names, and since the therapist’s version becomes yours bit by bit, it’s borrowed adulthood too.
